title: Relationship between body mass index, cytokines, and cognitive function in breast cancer survivors on aromatase inhibitors

risk_of_bias.notes: Cross-sectional, N=66, non-parametric RFR models (no standard β). Convenience sample, predominantly white (93.4%), single-site.

notes: Machine learning (Random Forest Regression) to identify cytokine predictors of cognition in BCS 6mo-10yr post-chemo. R² values reported for full models; no individual standardized coefficients available. Key: IL-10/IL-7/IL-4→verbal fluency; IL-1β/IL-2→verbal memory; IL-4/IL-1β/TNF-α→delayed memory; GM-CSF/IL-8/IL-2→processing speed; IL-1β/IL-2→executive; no cytokine predictors for FACT-Cog.
